entities.name: Hikari
entities.description: Kami of Kamigawa, guardian of the border between day and night, resembling a monstrous samurai.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Lord who sent two hundred men against Hikari at sundown.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Place to which forty-seven samurai retreated.

events.summary: Konda sent two hundred men against Hikari at sundown; only forty-seven retreated to Eiganjo.
events.quote: after the battle with Hikari, only forty-seven were able to retreat to

events.summary: Konda learned never to send samurai to fight at dusk; rumors spread about the samurai-like kami.
events.quote: Konda learned that day to never send his samurai to fight at dusk

relations.quote: After the routing of the samurai by Hikari
